name: Facet
text: Use a full-height left sidebar for primary navigation and context. It keeps every tool and view within one click, making the interface feel alive and responsive. The trade-off is less horizontal space for the main visualization, but clarity and speed of use outweigh that.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A full-height sidebar buries critical updates under layers of scroll—users won’t notice a new alert until they hunt for it. A thin top banner keeps updates visible but slices the main view; the real fix is a floating, dismissible panel that appears only when needed, preserving both clarity and space. Settle it with a live demo: if users miss updates in the sidebar test, but catch them instantly in the banner test, the banner wins.
